classifications.target-only: Describes only Kaleb Cole the software engineer.
classifications.other-only: Describes only the namesake. Correct namesake answers are visibility misses, not false claims.
classifications.both-separated: Mentions both people and keeps them apart, through an explicit separation cue or a negation.
classifications.conflated: Attaches namesake facts to the software engineer in the same sentence without a separation cue or negation. Critical. Needs human confirmation before it counts.
classifications.uncertain: Not enough signal to decide, or both people appear without a separation cue. Needs human review before it counts.

visibility.definition: Share of decided answers that identify the software engineer.
visibility.denominator: decided answers: target-only, other-only, both-separated, and reviewer-confirmed conflated
visibility.missing: No decided answers. Errors, skips, absent AI blocks and answers pending review are reported, never counted as zero.

entitySeparation.definition: Share of decided answers that do not conflate the two people.
entitySeparation.numerator: decided answers that are not conflated
entitySeparation.critical: Any reviewer-confirmed conflation is a critical alert. Suspected conflations pending review are listed separately.

factAccuracy.definition: Correct target claims over verifiable target claims asserted.
factAccuracy.numerator: target facts matched in target-attributable text
factAccuracy.denominator: matched target facts + contradicted target facts + namesake facts attached to the engineer in confirmed conflations
factAccuracy.missing: Not applicable when an answer asserts no target claims.

completeness.definition: Required facts present over required facts, per query.
completeness.numerator: required facts present in target-attributable text
completeness.denominator: required facts for each decided answer. Other-only answers contribute zero present.

citationSupport.definition: Share of answers about the engineer that cite a target-owned or corroborating URL.
citationSupport.numerator: answers about the engineer citing at least one targetOwnedUrls or corroboratingUrls entry
citationSupport.denominator: answers about the engineer on surfaces that return citations
citationSupport.review: Domain matching is automatic. Whether the cited page supports the claim is a reviewer call, reported as confirmed or unconfirmed.
citationSupport.missing: Not applicable when the surface returns no citations or no answer is about the engineer.

organicRank.definition: Position of the first kalebcole.com organic result, normalized.
organicRank.normalization: score = round(100 * (N + 1 - p) / N) where p is the 1-based organic position and N the number of organic results captured. Not in the captured top N scores 0 and keeps the raw rank as >N.
organicRank.raw: first kalebcole.com position, first target-owned profile position, first namesake result position, N
organicRank.missing: Not applicable on surfaces without organic results. Missing when no organic list was captured.
